name: torus-gland
why: The torus's main use — an O-ring gland. UnifySameDomain used to segfault on the coaxial circular seams a torus groove leaves in a cylinder, and this case existed to keep that visible rather than remembered; the OCCT 8.0.1 upgrade fixed it and the marker came off, which is the marker working as designed. Assertions stay bounding box and watertightness, because they are what the case was written to prove.
